sections.title: Needs a decision
sections.sql: select title,asset,technician,status,due_date,reason from v_attention order by due_date nulls first

sections.title: Preventive work due
sections.sql: select name,asset,next_due,meter_value,next_meter,has_open_work from v_pm_due order by next_due

sections.title: Parts to replenish
sections.sql: select name,sku,stock,reorder_point,supplier from parts where stock<=reorder_point order by name

sections.title: Work costs by currency
sections.sql: select title,asset,currency,total_cost from v_costs order by currency,total_cost desc

sections.title: Inspection register
sections.sql: select name,status,inspection_due,interval_source,registration_ref from assets order by inspection_due nulls first

sections.title: Outstanding purchases
sections.sql: select name,supplier,expected_date,quantity*unit_cost as committed,currency from purchase_orders where status='ordered' order by expected_date
